title: Anomaly detection protected reference solution and review guide
answer: A strong submission for Anomaly detection should complete this objective: Compare Isolation Forest and Local Outlier Factor. It should demonstrate the expected outcome (Evaluate rare-observation detection.), use a consistent and reproducible setup, report evidence rather than speculation, and address the limitation: Review flagged normal cases as well as detected anomalies.
explanation: Review the result for technical correctness and reproducibility. The automatic check only looks for IsolationForest, LocalOutlierFactor, contamination and does not run the learner code. Review flagged normal cases as well as detected anomalies.
